game.title: Marvel's Avengers
game.blurb: Action brawler with a story campaign and co-op missions starring the Avengers, from Crystal Dynamics and Eidos Montreal, released 2020-09-04. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 997070)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Marvel's_Avengers
Fandom (marvels-avengers.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://marvels-avengers.fandom.com/wiki/Marvel's_Avengers
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). The game is no longer sold on Steam: app 997070 is not in the current Steam app list, but the Steam Web API still returns its achievement schema (named "Marvel's Avengers", 50 achievements) and global percentages, so it was used. Fandom's summary says online service ended on September 30, 2023 and the game was removed from digital storefronts that day. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. marvels-avengers.fandom.com answers the API, with about 198 linked pages, including hero pages such as "Kate Bishop", "Hawkeye", "Spider-Man" and "Black Panther"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 16 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Some of them (for example "Truly Elite", 3%, and "Golden Ticket", 69%) may not be story beats, but nothing in the data says what they are. The many online-only goals (War Zones, Hives, factions) may be hard or impossible to finish now the servers are off; this was not checked.
